blocks.title: Strategy pattern
blocks.text: The Strategy design pattern is like a toolbox full of different tools, each designed for a specific job: when you face a problem, you pick the right tool for the task. You have multiple ways to solve a problem and can switch between them easily without changing much else.

blocks.prompt: Give an example where a program might switch between strategies.
blocks.explanation: A route-planning app can choose the fastest, the shortest or the toll-free route; each is a strategy, and the app swaps between them without changing the rest of its code.

items: Strategy: several interchangeable ways to do a task, chosen as needed, like picking a tool from a toolbox.
